title: Should You Invest in the First Trust Technology AlphaDEX ETF (FXL)?
author: Na
description: The article provides an in-depth analysis of the First Trust Technology AlphaDEX ETF (FXL), a passively managed technology sector ETF with $2.73 billion in assets. title: Should You Invest in the iShares Expanded Tech Sector ETF (IGM)?

title: This Vanguard ETF Is Up 27% This Year: Is It Still a Buy for Long-Term Investors?
author: Marc Guberti
description: The Vanguard Information Technology Index Fund ETF (VGT) has surged 27% year-to-date, significantly outperforming the S&P 500. The fund's strong performance is driven by heavy exposure to chipmakers like Nvidia (17% of assets), Broadcom, Micron, and AMD, which are benefiting from AI infrastructure demand. With a 24.4% annualized return over the past decade and a low 0.09% expense ratio, the fund appears well-positioned for continued growth as the AI industry is projected to grow at 30.6% CAGR through 2033.

title: Should You Invest in the Invesco S&P SmallCap Information Technology ETF (PSCT)?
author: Zacks.Com
description: The Invesco S&P SmallCap Information Technology ETF (PSCT) is a passively managed fund offering broad exposure to small-cap tech companies with a low expense ratio of 0.29%.
